name: mandala
description: Mandala tokens (BRC-162; BRC-207; docs/MANDALA.md): one overlay topic per token, tm_mandala_<assetId> (the asset id <txid>_<vout>, <txid>_0 at output 0), judged by the token rules alone (mandala-topic), and its lookup ls_mandala_<assetId> (mandala-lookup: BRC-207's mandala-spendability and mandala-admission), both registered at runtime; the discovery topic tm_mandala (every token's deploy output), the lookup service ls_mandala (mandala-lookup: a token's unspent value outputs, its authority outputs, one output by outpoint) and ls_mandala_deploys (a token id's deploy output; a token id is <txid>, <txid>_<vout> or <txid>.<vout>); every name of mandala-lookup reads one index, <app>/ls_mandala; on the overlay engine (shruggr/skein-overlay 0.12.0, required: chain/1). The token list is a read route, /<app>/mandala/tokens (its filter tokens, mandala-lookup fn tokens: anyone, nothing logged; shruggr/skein#143): {limit?, skip?} → [{tokenId, topic, sym, dec, icon?, txid, vout}], every deploy tm_mandala admitted, newest first; icon a binary deploy's embedded image as a data URL, a BRC-161 JSON deploy's icon string as written. The manifest declares no topics: root registers each token with the engine, two messages in the app's box register (<app>/register once installed; the handler overlay.register, gated by roles: {root: [register, registerLookup, deregisterLookup]}): {fn: "register", args: {topic: "tm_mandala_<assetId>", program: "mandala-topic", seed?}} then {fn: "registerLookup", args: {service: "ls_mandala_<assetId>", program: "mandala-lookup", topics: ["tm_mandala_<assetId>"]}}, and drops it with {fn: "deregisterLookup", args: {service}} then {fn: "deregister", args: {topic}}; tm_mandala by register alone. Every skein is a market and a validator, always (skein-overlay 0.12.0): a registered topic has liveness and a beacon on <topic>-live (its body the topic's view digest), a registered lookup a beacon on <service>-live. The registered sets are the heads <app>/topics and <app>/lookups. ls_mandala and ls_mandala_deploys listen to every topic the overlay serves.
